name: Onegai,  Okaa-san tte Yonde! ~Gibo ni Naritai Onna to, Koibito ni Shitai Boku~
original_name: お願い、お義母さんって呼んで！ ～義母になりたいオンナと、恋人にしたいボク～
source: One day, the protagonist's father suddenly introduces a woman to him as his "new" mother-in-law from now on. He already knows too well that his father will change his partner again soon as that has always been the case until now. Therefore, he tries to behave like stranger to not get emotionally attached as much as possible. However, the moment he hears her voice and looks at her face, he realizes that he has fallen in love at first sight.
translation: 某天，父亲突然向主角介绍了一名女子，说她从今以后就是他的“新继母”。主角早就明白，父亲很快又会换一个伴侣，毕竟，从前一直如此。因此，他尽可能像陌生人一样与对方相处，避免投入感情。然而，听到她的声音，看见她面容的那一刻，他却意识到，自己已经一见钟情。
